title: Besicovitch-Federer projection theorem for almost every linear map (finite measure)
statement: Let N, m ∈ ℕ, k := m + 1, and let E ⊆ ℝ^N be a Borel set with Hᵏ(E) < ∞ (Hᵏ = μHE[k]) which is purely k-unrectifiable. Then for Lebesgue-almost every v = (v₁, …, v_k) ∈ (ℝ^N)^k, the image of E under the linear map L_v : ℝ^N → ℝᵏ, x ↦ (⟨v₁,x⟩, …, ⟨v_k,x⟩), has Lebesgue measure zero in ℝᵏ.
lean_statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (E : Set (Eucl N)), MeasurableSet E → (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl N)) E < ∞ → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.PurelyUnrectifiable (m + 1) E → ∀ᵐ v ∂(volume : Measure (Fin (m + 1) → Eucl N)), (volume : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))) ((fun x : Eucl N => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) x) : Eucl (m + 1))) '' E) = 0
